rules.name: Blue_done
rules.label: Blue complete and not yet locked

Flow.description: Before-save. (1) Send-back: when Color Review Stage moves backward to an earlier color, increments Send Back Count and clears the Completed Date and sign-offs of that color and every later color (and unlocks pricing if Blue is reopened). (2) Auto-complete: stamps a color's Completed Date the moment its required sign-offs and deliverables are all in. (3) Locks pricing once Blue is complete. (4) Stamps the date on each sign-off box when it is first checked.

formulas.name: fIsSendBack
formulas.expression: AND(CASE(TEXT({!$Record.Color_Review_Stage__c}), "Pink Review",1, "Red Review",2, "Blue Review",3, "Gold Review",4, "Green Review",5, "Complete",6, 0) < CASE(TEXT({!$Record__Prior.Color_Review_Stage__c}), "Pink Review",1, "Red Review",2, "Blue Review",3, "Gold Review",4, "Green Review",5, "Complete",6, 0), CASE(TEXT({!$Record.Color_Review_Stage__c}), "Pink Review",1, "Red Review",2, "Blue Review",3, "Gold Review",4, "Green Review",5, "Complete",6, 0) >= 1, CASE(TEXT({!$Record.Color_Review_Stage__c}), "Pink Review",1, "Red Review",2, "Blue Review",3, "Gold Review",4, "Green Review",5, "Complete",6, 0) <= 5)
